item.title: CBO forecasts growing budget deficit amid tax cuts, tariffs
item.description: The CBO forecasts the U.S. budget deficit will rise to $1.853 trillion in fiscal 2026, with debt reaching 120% of GDP by 2036.

item.title: Strategists foresee 10-year Treasury yields rising on inflation
item.description: Reuters survey shows 10-year Treasury yields rising later this year on inflation and Fed independence concerns, while short-term yields ease on rate-cut bets.

item.title: Shipping industry pushes ahead on green investments
item.description: Global shipping firms continue investing billions in dual-fuel vessels and alternative fuels despite a delayed IMO carbon price and U.S. opposition.

item.title: U.S. firms confront widening consumer income gulf
item.description: Premium brands and airlines thrive as lower-income households pull back, highlighting a widening K-shaped recovery in U.S. consumer spending.

item.title: Milwaukee Tool advances Menomonee Falls campus expansion
item.description: Milwaukee Tool moves forward with plans to expand its Menomonee Falls campus with three new buildings, nearly 500,000 square feet and potential wetland impacts.

item.title: On the Market: Twin Cities flex industrial and retail for sale
item.description: Flex industrial properties in Little Canada and Long Lake plus a new Eagan retail day care center offer investor and owner-occupant opportunities.

item.title: Cannabis facility proposed for St. Cloud industrial site
item.description: A proposed entertainment center in St. Cloud could be replaced by a cannabis cultivation facility creating 85 jobs and generating $631,000 in annual tax revenue.

item.title: Chaska weighs 2M-square-foot Big Woods Business Park
item.description: Chaska may see nearly 2 million square feet of industrial space as Scannell advances Big Woods Business Park, a major project near Highway 212 now under review.

item.title: Bigos buys downtown apartments for $35M
item.description: Bigos Management purchased the 175-unit Mill District City Club Apartments in downtown Minneapolis for over $35 million and plans a full renovation.

item.title: Interview: Alex Baron, co-founder, Stack Industrial Partners
item.description: Alex Baron, co-founder of Stack Industrial Partners talks about the new firm, its goals and what challenges he anticipates for Stack Industrial in its first year.
